acceptance_predicates.description: Product-root paths are independently allowlisted and valid in-scope paths are admitted.
State-root paths are independently allowlisted and valid in-scope paths are admitted.
Missing or empty path declarations are rejected fail-closed.
Traversal, absolute, symlink, and normalized escape paths are rejected for both roots.
A path from one root cannot be used under the other root or publication target.
Existing single-root envelopes retain their behavior and exact digest bindings.
Publication is limited to the declared root-specific allowlist and rejects widening.

definition_of_done: Implement the smallest coordinator-native multi-root envelope/publication scope repair on an exact reviewed head.
Add offline positive and negative contract tests for product-root, state-root, missing, traversal, wrong-root, publication widening, and single-root compatibility.
Preserve existing identity, lifecycle, command, evidence, privacy, and release gates; record exact-head validation and downstream handoff evidence.

inputs.description: Merged Coordinator execution-envelope contract and immutable binding behavior.

outputs.description: Versioned product-root/state-root path and publication scope contract.

Exact reviewed Coordinator repair and release handoff.

gates.description: Independent review covers the exact Coordinator commit and confirms root-specific fail-closed scope.
Required native and hosted quality checks pass on the exact reviewed head.
Publication evidence demonstrates exact declared root scope without widening.
